database-made-again-under-its-name, with the new reads given one file at a time. The first node keeps the evidence of the sources that were not read again yet, so it stays until the last of them is read. Each name goes to the new node when its source is read again: the first node is stated by nothing but names by then, and a name does not hold a node for another name. The end is the model of database-made-again-under-its-name.
